tasks.task: Reusable commercial pack and campaign readiness
tasks.overlap_rule: Do not recreate or reprice the complete report, its commercial preview, or initial report use-option analysis already in WR09/WR16. A second campaign reuses the asset and costs only real updating work.

tasks.task: Campaign administration, pipeline review and close
tasks.overlap_rule: No automatic monthly sales team, retainer, CRM purchase or annual campaign count. Distinguish common review from the same customer contact/proposal work.
Excludes substantive meeting work in WS04 and preparation/negotiation already in WS05/WS06. Not a lead quota, permission to contact or inferred conversion funnel.

tasks.task: Substantive sales discussion and immediate record
tasks.overlap_rule: T03 exploratory research is excluded. A no-show records only genuinely incurred preparation/handling, not an invented completed meeting; any real extra effort is retained in the same task record.
One partner proposal is one attempt, not a separate licence proposal plus briefing proposal for the same combined offer. This is proposal preparation, not new research or current Table feasibility.

tasks.task: Additional material proposal or negotiation round
tasks.overlap_rule: If a complete fresh proposal is counted in WS05, do not also count that same writing in WS06. Record preparation, call and revision within one round once.

tasks.task: Won order / agreement and entitlement setup
tasks.overlap_rule: Count the agreement once even if it includes a licence and briefing. Negotiation incurred before a lost order belongs in WS05/WS06. A signature/order record is not receipt of cash or completed fulfilment.

tasks.task: Customer-specific reading path through existing research
tasks.overlap_rule: The full free research benefit remains intact. Generic summary/preview and existing reading-path assets are reused; do not re-charge WR09/WR16 or repeat the same path because a bundle has several labels. Fresh evidence collection is outside this task.

tasks.task: Scoped client/public-use asset preparation and context check
tasks.overlap_rule: Use the existing rights review and original design from WR10/WR12. Charge only the additional permitted adaptation/check; no default third-party chart/identity/quote rights, blanket sublicence or new evidence. Multiple genuinely different agreed packages can require repeated work.

If research is already commissioned/complete, do not describe it as a new commission. This task excludes the licence/briefing work counted in WS07–WS09/WS12–WS15. No contact access, seats, exclusivity, favourable conclusions or recurring reporting is presumed.

No default monthly report or newly compulsory partner service. Reuse invoice, delivery and briefing records; do not redo the underlying work. Multiple real checks can create legitimate additional hours within the same bundle; do not remove them merely because the bundle is counted once.

A common batch is counted once; no second free-copy charge for the same send. An additional recipient-specific delivery action or separate run is incremental real work, not a second research-production cost. Effort depends on recipient/route complexity; override the hours when material.

No new research, unlimited inquiry or promised turnaround. Reuse a prepared briefing and count only the necessary preparation delta for a repeat audience/session. Where WS08 reading-path work is reused, credit only that exact saved task and allocate common person-time once. If an unchanged reusable preparation package supports several sessions, assign it once rather than duplicating full preparation. One joint session serving several entitled customers/partners is one session, not one per attendee or bundle.

Duration/headcount are planning choices, not promised session lengths or staffing. A second necessary presenter is real additional person-time; do not multiply the same full task hours by every role. A repeat session is a real repeat unit even if preparation is reused.

No general analyst inquiry desk, compliance advice, bespoke consulting, new study or recurring support is assumed. If one shared follow-up is reused for multiple sessions, allocate the common work once; genuinely different follow-up remains incremental.

WS18 contains resolution and closing work for this same case; do not include it here. Paid, bundled and free recipients can create cases. No new support entitlement or participant form is created; fresh research/advice is outside the scope.

Invoice, cash receipt and delivery remain different statuses. Do not count invoice value and receipt as two revenues. Costs already included in supplier/package/admin fees are reconciled once. No tax/recovery/payment-platform rule is presumed.

tasks.task: Service-case resolution, correction routing and close
tasks.overlap_rule: New source/content correction, narrative revision, QA and ordinary contractual remedy stay in WR10/WR13/WR14 or the appropriate production route; this row contains only incremental customer resolution/routing/redistribution and does not create an extra fee. If several cases share a correction notice/replacement send, prepare/send it once and allocate that common work once; do not also count the same send in WS12. A separately requested new study or advisory service is not included.

tasks.task: Actually initiated renewal or expiry administration
tasks.overlap_rule: No auto-renewal, subscription, annual update, future council tenure or new edition is assumed. New prospecting/proposal/research work belongs in the relevant task once; do not add a full second sales cycle here by default.

This T02 benefit idea is uncommitted. No promised answer to every practitioner question, monthly note, advice desk, new research or event production. Distribution uses WS12 once; the same note is not produced separately for each partner/free recipient.

tasks.task: Campaign fulfilment readiness and distribution-route setup
tasks.overlap_rule: WR14 already covers final report QA and portable JGA handover; do not repeat it. Reuse an existing tested release/route and count only the genuinely necessary readiness check/update. If multiple campaigns share an unchanged configuration, allocate its setup once and retain only actual incremental checks. No new website, platform purchase or access restriction is required.

units.counting_note: One explicitly defined selling campaign using a named edition/offer. Confirm actual offered outputs, fulfilment boundaries, commercial description and reusable proposal/entitlement templates.

One actual individually handled approach or short follow-up attempt, including no response, decline or failed contact. Record each genuinely separate attempt; a bulk action is not many individually worked attempts.
One actual substantive commercial needs/fit discussion: relevant preparation, discussion and immediate note. Includes discussions that do not lead to a proposal or sale.

One actual initial written scoped commercial proposal for a named prospect/order, whether won, lost, declined or unanswered. Define edition/use, bundle entitlements, service preparation, price/terms to be agreed and delivery capability.
One genuinely additional material negotiation/revision round beyond the initial scoped proposal work, including a failed negotiation. An ordinary document save or unchanged resend is not a round.
One actually agreed customer order or partner bundle: execute/capture agreed terms, record edition/version, recipient/use/service entitlements, delivery route and responsible owner.
One genuinely requested/scoped task-based route through the already completed full edition and existing tools. Count only actual additional preparation for this user/use.
One defined asset package for an actually agreed client/public use: exact original material/version, relevant contextual/source checks, attribution and necessary adaptation/layout.
One won partner bundle: accurately describe the funded work, agree/capture recognition and logo permissions where relevant, and record the specific benefits and delivery owner.

One actual prepared distribution run/batch using the named full edition and agreed route: recipient/access list handling, send/access action and basic delivery reconciliation. Paid, bundled and free practitioner copies can share the same run.

One actual agreed session, including a partner-bundled session: confirm audience/use/agenda, arrange it and prepare supported existing findings/material. Planning hours are total preparer/coordinator person-hours.

One actual access/use/service issue: receive, identify affected edition/entitlement, distinguish an ordinary correction from a new request, assign the appropriate owner and record status. Count the issue once, not every reply.

One actual invoice/collection cycle: create/check invoice, routine agreed follow-up, reconcile receipt and link it to the order and fulfilment record. Count additional genuinely separate staged invoices as separate cycles only for their incremental work.

One actual renewal/expiry case if a defined term or genuinely wanted next edition makes it relevant, including a renewal that does not proceed. Confirm version/entitlements/status and close or route the case.

One separately chosen short note drawing on existing permitted material: useful takeaways, evidence limits, unresolved questions and indirect-identification review. One shared note can serve all permitted recipients.

next_step: Event/participant operations, moderation, travel and dated cash before the complete matched A/B pilot/annual model.
